name: base_utils
description: Common host utility module that optionally manages /etc/motd and installs a Hiera-defined list of utility packages.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Provisions an ordered Python application stack, including runtime, database prerequisites, application source and configuration, systemd service, monitoring, log rotation, and support scripts.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with package installation, generated configuration, optional backend discovery, firewall rules, service management, logging, statistics, and TLS.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Installs and manages PostgreSQL using a PGDG repository, configurable package and version selection, and service management.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures a Redis cluster with configurable port, password, memory policy, Redis installation, and node discovery through PuppetDB.
